sloka: बहुवर्षसहस्राणि बहुवर्षशतानि च ।श्वभ्रे ऽस्मिन् कृकलासो वै दीर्घकालं वसिष्यसि ।। ७.५३.१९ ॥
transliteration: bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi bahuvarṣaśatāni ca ।śvabhre 'smin kṛkalāso vai dīrghakālaṁ vasiṣyasi ।। 7.53.19 ॥

translations.english: For many thousands and hundreds of years, you will indeed reside in this pit as a chameleon for a long duration.
